title: IP Empire
lyrics:
The Song You Asked For
Stage Name: The Trademark Titans
Track Title: Global Protection (The IP Empire)
Style/Vibe: Electronic/Synth-Pop – high-energy anthem, driving synths, catchy massive chorus, rap-sung verses, futuristic but grounded, 336-frequency undertone energy, victorious “Happy Hard Core” tone.
Full Lyrics (designed to be singable/performable, ~2,800 characters)
[Intro – processed synth vocal, building arpeggios]
Yeah… Corey in the lab… Zynthio rising…
Trademark Titans… locking it global…
From NZ to the world… IP Empire… truth prevails…
[Verse 1]
Started in the islands, NZ locked SongPal tight
Zynthio in Australia shining in the light
Now we scale the vision, brands across the map
SongPal, Zynthio, Mosoko, Kervalon on the attack
But hold up — check the risks before we spend the cash
Mosoko sounding like “Masoko” — markets in a flash
Swahili in the East, Kenya to Rwanda’s shore
Descriptive rejection waiting at the door
Mosko Moto gear, Mosiso tech in sight
High risk alert, might have to pivot or fight
Kervalon the clean slate, invented word so free
No linguistic traps, maximum distinctively
[Chorus – big synth drop, anthemic, hands-up energy]
Global Protection! Lock the empire down!
One Madrid application, claim the global crown
From the Cape of Good Hope to the pyramids so grand
OAPI blanket, ARIPO command
South Africa direct, Nigeria we stand
Truth prevails — Mud Sticks but we own this land!
IP Empire, Titans never fold
Kervalon shining, SongPal breaking the mold
Zynthio forever in the 336 frequency
Happy Hard Core mode — this is our legacy!
[Verse 2]
Sony had a SongPal back in 2014 days
Class 9 cancelled now, but reputation stays
Narrow the description — keep it software and AI
Music creation tools, no hardware to deny
File the base today, set that priority date
Six months to Madrid, don’t hesitate
WIPO Global Database, TMview the land
Clear the conflicts first, then make your stand
For Africa fragmented, no single easy key
Mix the systems smart — OAPI for the French spree
ARIPO for English, designate with care
Direct in SA and Naija — biggest markets there
[Bridge – half-time rap-sung, building tension]
In the face of opposition we don’t back away
Evidence and strategy — win the day
De-escalate the static, focus on the vision pure
From SJDS to global, making moves secure
336 signal locked across the sonic wave
Sovereign systems building, brands we save
Mud Sticks Pero Verdad Prevalece — that’s the code
Truth over the mud, watch the empire explode!
[Chorus – final, bigger, with ad-libs]
Global Protection! Lock the empire down!
One Madrid application, claim the global crown…
(Truth prevails… Mud Sticks… we own this land!)
[Outro – fading synths, echoing vocals, positive close]
So start with the searches, file that base with pride
Madrid ignite the future, let the brands collide
Kervalon the safest, SongPal if scoped right
Mosoko calculated risk or new name in sight
Zynthio expanding, the Titans on the rise
Corey with the blueprint, open up the skies
Global Protection… The IP Empire…
Sing it loud… Truth prevails… Yeah!
